text: 기준시점(라시디핀 최초 처방일)부터 사망·자료 관찰 종료 중 최초까지 추적 (추적기간: 12주)
query: WITH lacidipine_index AS ( SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN ({{라시디핀}}) GROUP BY de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT li.person_id, li.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, li.index_date + INTERVAL '84' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM lacidipine_index li JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = li.person_id AND li.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = li.person_id AND d.death_date >= li.index_date ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '12_WEEK_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

text: 이상지질혈증 진단 이력이 있으면서 아토르바스타틴 최초 처방일 이전의 아토르바스타틴 처방 이력이 없는 환자 코호트를 아토르바스타틴 최초 처방일을 기준일로 하여 추출하라.

query: WITH lacidipine_index AS ( SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN ({{라시디핀}}) GROUP BY de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT li.person_id, li.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, li.index_date + INTERVAL '84' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM lacidipine_index li JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = li.person_id AND li.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = li.person_id AND d.death_date >= li.index_date ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '12_WEEK_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

text: 라시디핀 최초 처방일로부터 12주 추적 종료일을 대상자별로 계산하되, 사망, 관찰 종료, 추적 상한 중 가장 빠른 시점을 기준으로 종료 사유를 판정
query: WITH lacidipine_index AS ( SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN ({{라시디핀}}) GROUP BY de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT li.person_id, li.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, li.index_date + INTERVAL '84' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM lacidipine_index li JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = li.person_id AND li.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = li.person_id AND d.death_date >= li.index_date ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '12_WEEK_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

query: WITH first_exposure AS (SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date FROM drug_exposure de WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN ({{로수바스타틴}}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drug_exposure prior_de WHERE prior_de.person_id = de.person_id AND prior_de.drug_concept_id IN ({{로수바스타틴}}) AND prior_de.drug_exposure_start_date < de.drug_exposure_start_date)), qualified_exposure AS (SELECT fe.person_id, fe.drug_exposure_start_date FROM first_exposure fe WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.person_id = fe.person_id AND co.condition_concept_id IN ({{이상지질혈증}}) AND co.condition_start_date <= fe.drug_exposure_start_date)) SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date FROM qualified_exposure GROUP BY person_id;

text: 글리메피리드 최초 처방일을 기준시점으로 하고 관찰기간과 일치하는 개인에 대해 사망일, 자료 관찰 종료일, 112일 중 선행 종료 시점과 사유를 산출해
query: WITH index_dates AS ( select de.person_id, min(de.drug_exposure_start_date) as index_date from drug_exposure de where de.drug_concept_id IN ({{글리메피리드}}) group by de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '112' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '112' DAY ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '16_WEEK_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

text: 사망·자료 관찰 종료·추적기간(16주) 도달 중 가장 먼저 오는 시점 (기준: 글리메피리드 최초 처방일)
query: WITH index_dates AS ( select de.person_id, min(de.drug_exposure_start_date) as index_date from drug_exposure de where de.drug_concept_id IN ({{글리메피리드}}) group by de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '112' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '112' DAY ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '16_WEEK_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

query: WITH index_dates AS ( select de.person_id, min(de.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence de where de.procedure_concept_id IN ({{항암화학요법}}) group by de.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '29' MONTH AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '29' MONTH ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '29_MONTH_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

text: 경피관상동맥중재술 또는 심근경색의 최초 발생일을 조회.
query: WITH proc_first AS (SELECT po.person_id AS person_id, MIN(po.procedure_date) AS first_event_date FROM procedure_occurrence po WHERE po.procedure_concept_id IN ({{경피관상동맥중재술}}) GROUP BY po.person_id), cond_first AS (SELECT co.person_id AS person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_event_date FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN ({{심근경색}}) GROUP BY co.person_id) SELECT COALESCE(pf.person_id, cf.person_id) AS person_id, CASE WHEN MIN(pf.first_event_date) IS NULL THEN MIN(cf.first_event_date) WHEN MIN(cf.first_event_date) IS NULL THEN MIN(pf.first_event_date) WHEN MIN(pf.first_event_date) <= MIN(cf.first_event_date) THEN MIN(pf.first_event_date) ELSE MIN(cf.first_event_date) END AS first_event_date FROM proc_first pf FULL OUTER JOIN cond_first cf ON pf.person_id = cf.person_id GROUP BY COALESCE(pf.person_id, cf.person_id);

text: 경피관상동맥중재술 또는 심근경색의 최초 발생일을 조회.
query: WITH outcome_events AS (SELECT po.person_id, po.procedure_date AS event_date FROM procedure_occurrence po WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM procedure_occurrence po_exists WHERE po_exists.procedure_concept_id = po.procedure_concept_id AND po_exists.procedure_concept_id IN ({{경피관상동맥중재술}})) UNION ALL SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_start_date AS event_date FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM condition_occurrence co_exists WHERE co_exists.condition_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id AND co_exists.condition_concept_id IN ({{심근경색}}))) SELECT outcome_events.person_id, MIN(outcome_events.event_date) AS first_event_date FROM outcome_events GROUP BY outcome_events.person_id;

text: 사망·자료 관찰 종료·추적기간(14일) 도달 중 가장 먼저 오는 시점 (기준: 경피관상동맥중재술(PCI) 시술일)
query: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN ({{경피관상동맥중재술}}) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '14' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '14' DAY ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '14_DAY_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

query: SELECT COALESCE(c.person_id, v.person_id) AS person_id, CASE WHEN c.min_date IS NULL THEN v.min_date WHEN v.min_date IS NULL THEN c.min_date WHEN c.min_date < v.min_date THEN c.min_date ELSE v.min_date END AS first_event_date FROM (SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS min_date FROM condition_occurrence co WHERE co.condition_concept_id IN ({{심부전}}) GROUP BY co.person_id) c FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT vo.person_id, MIN(vo.visit_start_date) AS min_date FROM visit_occurrence vo WHERE vo.visit_concept_id IN ({{입원}}) GROUP BY vo.person_id) v ON (c.person_id = v.person_id OR (c.person_id IS NULL AND v.person_id IS NULL));

text: 기준시점(동정맥루 조성술 시술일)부터 사망·자료 관찰 종료 중 최초까지 추적 (추적기간: 180일)
query: WITH index_dates AS ( select po.person_id, min(po.procedure_date) as index_date from procedure_occurrence po where po.procedure_concept_id IN ({{동정맥루 조성술}}) group by po.person_id ), follow_up_candidates AS ( SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '180' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date >= i.index_date AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '180' DAY ) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND f.death_date <= f.observation_period_end_date AND f.death_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '180_DAY_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;

query: WITH index_dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT x.person_id, x.index_date FROM (SELECT po.person_id, MIN(po.procedure_date) OVER (PARTITION BY po.person_id) AS index_date FROM procedure_occurrence po WHERE po.procedure_concept_id IN ({{동정맥루 조성술}})) x), follow_up_candidates AS (SELECT i.person_id, i.index_date, d.death_date, op.observation_period_end_date, i.index_date + INTERVAL '180' DAY AS maximum_follow_up_date FROM index_dates i JOIN observation_period op ON op.person_id = i.person_id AND i.index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date LEFT JOIN death d ON d.person_id = i.person_id AND d.death_date <= i.index_date + INTERVAL '180' DAY AND d.death_date >= i.index_date) SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT (f.death_date > f.observation_period_end_date OR f.death_date > f.maximum_follow_up_date) THEN f.death_date WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN f.observation_period_end_date ELSE f.maximum_follow_up_date END AS follow_up_end_date, CASE WHEN f.death_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT (f.death_date > f.observation_period_end_date OR f.death_date > f.maximum_follow_up_date) THEN 'DEATH' WHEN f.observation_period_end_date <= f.maximum_follow_up_date THEN 'OBSERVATION_END' ELSE '180_DAY_END' END AS follow_up_end_reason FROM follow_up_candidates f;
